summary: Docshell navigation is being made more resilient and harder for content to misuse: Firefox can retry HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 requests after an unclean shutdown, rate-limits navigations, validates session-history data and process-specific IDs, and restricts sensitive BrowsingContext and DevTools state changes to the parent process. The work also improves URL fixup and keyword searches, session-history handling, APZ autoscroll reporting, and scrollbar boundaries around rounded browser UI. These changes mainly strengthen reliability, navigation security, and browser chrome behavior.
